CUSTOS does not load dumps into a server by itself. When a database is needed back, run the commands below.
Run them in cmd, not in PowerShell (PowerShell spoils the input given with «<»), from the folder that holds the folder «db».
The programs mysql (mariadb), psql and createdb are in the folder of the server's programs (bin): go there first or write the full path to them.
The commands ask for the password of the server's administrator (root, postgres); write another user if yours is different.
Load a database into an empty one: tables already there get in the way.
